Class ViewLessonDetails

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDetails.ViewLessonDetails
public final class ViewLessonDetails extends Object
KG02/KG03/KG06 four-field read view with current lock capabilities and navigation. No timestamps or lock states are fabricated when the current data model lacks them.
